description: Applying Moves. Each case applies moves to start (a solved Cube when start is absent) and must produce expect. solved is whether the result counts as solved: every face a single color, in any orientation. A state is the 54 Stickers as seen: six groups of nine color letters (W Y G B R O), one group per face in the order U R F D L B, each read row by row as laid out in the internal/cube package doc. States were produced by a reference model checked against the kociemba README example, the checkerboard and the superflip, not by either model under test.
